versions.changelog:
Initial release of ingest-preflight.

- Validates a skill folder before publishing to ClawHub, ensuring required files and frontmatter are present.
- Checks for recommended structure (like references/ directory) and large file sizes.
- Verifies authentication and CLI setup, plus slug availability.
- Performs a dry-run publish to catch errors before real deployment.
- Returns detailed feedback to help fix structural issues before publishing.
